name: Broken Hearted
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately near to those who are brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering deliverance and healing to those in their distress. The psalmist affirms that the LORD hears the cries of the righteous and binds up their wounds, demonstrating His compassion toward those who come to Him with humility and repentance. True trust in God, rather than in our own understanding, is foundational for strength when our hearts fail, as He becomes our enduring portion and rock.
